title: Accumulator instruction selector
statement: Let $a,b,f$ be natural numbers, let $c$ be a Boolean value, and let $i$ be a natural number. Define an instruction to be the $i$th of two accumulator increments when $i<2$, and otherwise the test of register $d$, with $c$ remembered in either case.
